correction_of_previous_analysis: zlib-wmf-svg-analysis.json said the rebuilt fonts output for image10.wmf was untrustworthy. That was wrong: the font-substitution lookup in CInterpretatorSvgBase.cpp:332 and CEmfInterpretatorSvg.cpp:1251 is guarded by #ifndef BUILDING_WASM_MODULE, and libfont.json defines BUILDING_WASM_MODULE, so the fonts engine never runs it. Only the 2022-era zlib recipe lacked the define and compiled the lookup, which dereferenced the NULL font manager created by MetaFile::Create(NULL).

fix.change: add define BUILDING_WASM_MODULE to the zlib recipe (as libfont.json and drawingfile.json of the same snapshot)
